lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone comedy episode: perekupy sue the bot in court. Lis is a deadpan court reporter. Start mysterious and slow («На бота.» — after a pause, ironic). Calm, dry, numbers said fully.

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Line 1: outraged, loud, theatrical. Line 2: embarrassed, mumbling, pause after «Ну…». Line 3: suspicious, surprised.

judge.profile: A Russian judge in his 60s, grey beard and glasses: stern, formal court voice with dry humour.
judge.notes: «Встать, суд идёт!» — loud, formal. «То есть бот просто быстрее вас?» — ironic. «Иск отклонить» — formal, final. «А ссылку на бот — секретарю» — quieter, aside. «Камри ищу» — casual, a little embarrassed.

nina.profile: Baba Nina — a kind talkative Russian village grandmother in her 70s.
nina.notes: One line: amazed, warm, lively storytelling.

stas.profile: Stas — an exhausted Russian used-car flipper in his 30s who hasn't slept for three days.
